response.sql:
SELECT 
  COALESCE(p.bats, '') AS bats,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ma.player_id) AS award_winner_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ma.player_id) * 1.0 / (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) 
    FROM manager_award 
    WHERE player_id IN (SELECT player_id FROM player)
  ) AS share_of_total
FROM manager_award ma
INNER JOIN player p ON ma.player_id = p.player_id
GROUP BY COALESCE(p.bats, '')
ORDER BY award_winner_count DESC;

assumptions.assumption: "Manager award winners" refers to distinct players who won manager awards, not individual award instances; a player with multiple manager awards counts as one winner

alternatives.interpretation: Count each manager award instance separately, so a player winning multiple awards is counted once per award
alternatives.sql:
SELECT 
  COALESCE(p.bats, '') AS bats,
  COUNT(*) AS award_count,
  COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (
    SELECT COUNT(*) 
    FROM manager_award 
    WHERE player_id IN (SELECT player_id FROM player)
  ) AS share_of_total
FROM manager_award ma
INNER JOIN player p ON ma.player_id = p.player_id
GROUP BY COALESCE(p.bats, '')
ORDER BY award_count DESC;
